text:
Marta Ruiz: Hi all :wave: I’m Marta — I start today on Eng Platform (Madrid, CET). Quick questions: laptop arrived (MacBook Air), but I can’t reach internal docs and I don’t have VPN/Okta access yet. Who do I ping for VPN/profile and repo access? Also who’s my onboarding buddy? Happy to grab virtual coffee later. Fun fact: I used to play the accordion. :)

Alex Chen: Welcome Marta! :tada: I’m Alex — your onboarding buddy. Ping me any time. For VPN/Okta ping @IT Ops or @eng-infra — Sam usually sorts profiles. I’ll help with repo access too.

Priya Nair: Hey Marta — cc @IT Ops. For repo access please open an IT request at https://intranet.redwood.com/it-requests and include your employee ID. If you need faster access, Alex can add you to the staging group temporarily.

Sam (eng-infra): Hi Marta — I see ticket #3421. I’ll finish the VPN profile shortly. When you get the email, follow the steps and run:

```
sudo openvpn --config ~/downloads/redwood_profile.ovpn
```

That will create the tunnel and add the route.

Alex Chen: Onboarding checklist (short): 1) Okta MFA setup 2) Disk encryption 3) Slack + calendar 4) Repo + CI access. Tell me which step is stuck and I’ll jump in.

Marta Ruiz: Thanks — I tried the wiki and got 403 on /docs/eng/platform. I opened ticket 3421. Also my normal hours are 09:00–18:00 CET.

Priya Nair: :thumbsup: I’ll add you to team calendars and the #eng-platform invite. We have intro demos Mon/Wed but attendance is flexible. Heads up — demo day is next Friday if you want to watch.

Jae Park: Welcome Marta! Fun fact from our team — we have an office rubber duck named Quack. If you find Quack, it’s tradition to take a selfie with it and share in #random :duck:

Marta Ruiz: Love the duck. Accordion + duck = perfect icebreaker :grin:

Alex Chen: If you need the dev sandbox, run `./setup.sh --env=dev` in your terminal (should take ~10min). If it errors, paste the log here or DM me.

Marta Ruiz: Ran it now — failing at step 3 with `permission denied` on /var/tmp/cache. I’ll DM you the full log.

Priya Nair: Welcome again! If you want a 1:1 coffee intro I have 30min Tue 11:30 CET. Throw a calendar invite.

Alex Chen: Great — I’ll follow up on the repo invite and keep an eye on ticket #3421. Ping me for anything. :robot_face:
